app.name: Sehat Saathi
app.tagline: Har dawai waqt par. Har din ek hal-chaal.
common.error: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
common.offline: Internet nahi mil raha. Connection check karein.
server.waking: Server jag raha hai… thora intezar karein (30–60 second)
auth.name: Aap ka naam
auth.have_account: Pehle se account hai? Login karein
disclaimer.medical: Yeh maloomat doctor ki tasdeeq ke baghair istemal na karein. Apne doctor se zaroor poochein.
disclaimer.ai: Yeh AI sahayak hai, doctor nahi. Dawai ke baare mein apne doctor se poochein.
pharmacist.title: Pharmacist se tasdeeq karein
pharmacist.body: Is dawai ka kuch hissa saaf nahi parha gaya. Please confirm with a pharmacist.
home.reminders.sub: Yaad dehani aur li / nahi li
home.checkin: Aaj kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain?
home.next.none: Agle 24 ghante mein koi dawai nahi
upload.title: Nuskhe ki tasveer
upload.help: Nuskha seedha rakh kar, achi roshni mein tasveer lein. Sirf JPG, PNG ya WebP.
upload.too_big: Tasveer bohat bari hai. Doosri tasveer lein.
upload.bad_type: Yeh tasveer nahi lagti. JPG, PNG ya WebP chunein.
upload.not_rx: Is tasveer mein dawaiyan nahi milin. Doosri tasveer lein ya khud likh dein.
confirm.title: Dawaiyan check karein
confirm.help: Har dawai dhyan se dekhein. Ghalat ho to theek karein. Waqt zaroor set karein.
confirm.name: Dawai ka naam
confirm.saved: Dawaiyan mehfooz ho gayin. Yaad dehani lag gayi.
confirm.need_time: Har dawai ka kam az kam ek waqt set karein.
confirm.empty: Koi dawai nahi. Neeche se dawai likhein.
confirm.suggested: Ye waqt sirf mashwara hain — tasdeeq karein ya badlein.
rem.title: Aaj ki dawaiyan
rem.none: Abhi koi dawai nahi. Nuskhe ki tasveer se dawaiyan shamil karein.
rem.notify.denied: Notifications band hain. Browser settings se allow karein. App khula rahe to yaad dehani yahan bhi aayegi.
rem.notify.unsupported: Is browser mein notifications nahi. App khula rakhein — yaad dehani screen par aayegi.
rem.tab_note: Yaad dehani sirf tab aati hai jab Sehat Saathi browser mein khula ho.
rem.alert.title: Dawai ka waqt!
dash.title: Dashboard
push.elder.on: 🔔 Alarm on karein (app band ho tab bhi)
push.elder.enabled: Alarm on hai: app band ho tab bhi dawai ke waqt phone par alarm aayega.
push.carer.on: 🔔 Takleef par fori itlaa on karein
push.carer.enabled: Fori itlaa on hai: jab buzurg hal-chaal mein takleef batayenge, is phone par alert aayega.
push.denied: Notifications band hain. Browser settings mein is site ke liye notifications allow karein.
push.ios: iPhone par: Safari mein Share → "Add to Home Screen" karein, phir wahan se app khol kar alarm on karein.
landing.features.title: Sehat Saathi kya karta hai?
landing.f.scan.title: Nuskhe ki photo, dawaiyan tayyar
landing.f.scan.text: Parchi ki tasveer lein. AI dawai, miqdar aur waqt parh leta hai, aur aap khud tasdeeq karte hain.
landing.f.alarm.title: Waqt par alarm
landing.f.alarm.text: Har dawai ke waqt phone par yaad dehani, app band ho tab bhi.
landing.f.chotu.title: Chotu se roz baat
landing.f.chotu.text: Bol kar ya likh kar batayein aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain.
landing.f.family.title: Ghar wale aur doctor saath
landing.f.family.text: Ek code se jur kar woh dawaiyan, hal-chaal aur BP/sugar dekhte hain, aur takleef par fori itlaa paate hain.
landing.disclaimer: Prototype — asli mareezon ka data istemal na karein. Yeh doctor ka mutabadil nahi.
landing.chotu.note: Chotu ek AI sahayak hai, doctor nahi. Dawai ke baare mein apne doctor se poochein.
landing.chip.3: App band ho tab bhi alarm
landing.chips.label: Khaas baatein
landing.mock.title: Subah ki dawai ka waqt
landing.mock.ask: Aaj aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain?
landing.mock.family: Beti ko itlaa: Ammi ne dawai le li
landing.how.title: Kaise kaam karta hai?
landing.how.1.title: Parchi ki photo lein
landing.how.1.text: Doctor ki parchi camera ke saamne rakhein. Photo kahin save nahi hoti.
landing.how.2.title: Khud tasdeeq karein
landing.how.2.text: AI jo parhta hai woh aap ke saamne aata hai. Ghalti ho to theek kar dein.
landing.how.3.title: Waqt par yaad dehani
landing.how.3.text: Har dawai ke waqt alarm bajta hai. Aap "le li" ya "chhor di" dabayein.
landing.day.title: Subah se shaam tak, saath saath
landing.day.text: Chotu na thakta hai, na bhoolta hai. Woh har din chupke se aap ka khayal rakhta hai.
landing.day.1.title: Dawai ka alarm
landing.day.1.text: Ek bara alarm, saaf likha hua. Ek tap se "le li".
landing.day.2.title: Chotu se hal-chaal
landing.day.2.text: Bol kar ya likh kar batayein kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain.
landing.day.3.title: BP aur sugar likhein
landing.day.3.text: Ghar ki machine se parh kar number darj karein.
landing.day.4.title: Ghar walon ko khabar
landing.day.4.text: Takleef batayein to jure hue ghar walon ko fori itlaa jati hai.
landing.roles.title: Kis ke liye hai?
landing.roles.elder.title: Buzurg
landing.roles.elder.1: Dawai ka alarm aur yaad dehani
landing.roles.family.title: Ghar wale
landing.roles.family.2: Dawai aur mood ka hisaab dekhein
landing.roles.doctor.title: Doctor
landing.roles.doctor.1: BP, sugar aur dil ki dharkan dekhein
landing.roles.doctor.3: Sirf dekh sakte hain, badal nahi sakte
landing.trust.title: Bharosa, pehle din se
landing.trust.1.title: Photo save nahi hoti
landing.trust.1.text: Parchi ki tasveer sirf parhi jati hai, kahin rakhi nahi jati.
landing.trust.2.title: AI doctor nahi
landing.trust.2.text: Chotu sirf aam sehat ki baat karta hai. Ilaaj aur dawai doctor batata hai.
landing.trust.3.title: Sasti dawai? Pehle doctor
landing.trust.3.text: Har sasta mutabadil "doctor se tasdeeq zaroori" ke saath dikhaya jata hai.
landing.trust.4.title: Sirf aap ke apne
landing.trust.4.text: Data sirf woh ghar wale aur doctor dekhte hain jinhein aap ne code diya.
landing.cta.title: Aaj hi shuru karein
landing.cta.text: Do minute mein account banayein. Chotu aap ka intezar kar raha hai.
upload.dropzone.hint: Camera khulega. Puri parchi frame mein, achi roshni mein.
